intro: Welcome to Quiz Rush! Hungry? Today we're travelling the world through food. Forty famous dishes, from Easy to Genius. You have ten seconds each. Ready? Let's eat... I mean, let's play!
outro: That's the last bite! How many dishes did you get? Drop your score in the comments, and come back tomorrow, there's a brand new quiz every day on Quiz Rush!
